payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple methods for empirically evaluating data quality, including BLEU scores, perplexity measurements, and manual inspections.

claims.text: The quality of the data is evaluated using BLEU scores, which are calculated by grouping samples and averaging their scores.
Perplexity of translations is measured using a language model trained on clean monolingual data to assess translation quality.
Manual inspections are conducted for samples with low scores to ensure quality control in translations.
Sanity checks are applied to professional translations to control their quality.
